notes.title: Observe in Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.notes:
Hi,

Today the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase kicks off, marking the perfect time to play the demo before the launch later this year! We're open to all feedback and would love to hear what you think :)

Kind regards,
- Developers

notes.title: NEW DEMO Released!!!
notes.notes:
[NEW DEMO] After half a year we're finally able to show off the insane progress done by our team with this brand new completely refurbished demo - including new levels, a new story with voice acted audio logs and completely redone visuals!

This demo is the first two worlds of what you can expect in the final release and all of your progress will transfer once the full game releases!

And most importantly THANK YOU to everyone who shared and played the previous demo and gave feedback!! We could not have done this without you!!!! So stay tuned and we cannot wait to show u more:))

notes.title: Observe Demo Release!
notes.notes:
As of today, the Demo 1.0.0 version of Observe is available to play for free on your steam account! Play through ~45 minutes of content, 2 separate batches of levels with distinct mechanics and get a glimpse of what it means to "Observe".

Look forward to many more posts about the upcoming full release of Observe later this year! These will feature talk about new worlds, new mechanics and how we're making fulfilling levels with them.

Wishlist the game and tell us what you thought about the demo here: https://discord.gg/NxjvrtyEcR
